summary: Summarize many rows for each customer.
syntax: SELECT key, SUM(amount) AS total FROM table_name GROUP BY key;
documentation: GROUP BY partitions rows by the grouping expression. SUM adds non-NULL numeric values within each group.
inputs: Rows with a grouping key and numeric values.
caution: SUM returns NULL if there are no non-NULL inputs. Explicit ORDER BY controls result order.
scenarios: Calculate daily revenue from order records.
title: Total each customer's spending
problem: Return customer and SUM(amount_cents) AS total_cents from orders, grouped by customer and ordered by customer ascending. All amounts in this exercise are non-NULL integers.
goal: Use SUM() + GROUP BY or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
hint: Group by customer, name the sum total_cents, and sort by customer.
starter:
-- Write one SELECT query against the example tables.
SELECT 1;
